fixed.deleteConfirm: Delete fixed folder "{{name}}"? Open tabs will not be closed.
fixed.itemClose: Close tab and remove from folder
fixed.pendingHint: Waiting for a URL; the page will be saved here once opened
fixed.emptyHint: Click + to create a fixed folder, then drop tabs into that folder

search.title: Search tabs
search.placeholder: Search tabs in this window (title / URL / pinyin)
search.typeHint: Type a title, URL, or pinyin initials

settings.title: Settings
settings.threshold: Site grouping threshold (tabs per domain to auto-group)
settings.thresholdHint: Domains with fewer tabs than this are grouped by source; reaching the threshold auto-collapses them into one group
settings.tabOrderSyncHint: When on, drag tabs in the sidebar to reorder and sync to the browser's native tab order (native changes sync back too)
settings.exportDataHint: Exports fixed folders, pinned shortcuts, collapsed groups, and settings; open tabs are not included
settings.importDataHint: Validates the JSON locally, then replaces the exported data without changing open tabs
settings.importConfirm: Importing will replace current fixed data and settings. Continue?
settings.importFailed: Import failed: invalid or unreadable backup
settings.showPinnedStripHint: Show fixed website tiles at the top of the sidebar
settings.sidePanelPositionHint: Chrome controls this position. Choose left or right in Chrome's side panel settings; TabHaven follows it automatically
settings.showUrlHint: Show the full URL below the tab title
settings.showSplitBadgesHint: Show "拆 / 伴" badges for tabs in browser split view
settings.autoScrollActiveHint: Scroll the current tab into the visible area when switching
settings.closeOnMiddleClickHint: Click a tab row with the middle mouse button to close it
settings.autoDiscardHint: Automatically freeze tabs that haven't been visited for a set period to free memory
settings.previewDesc: Show a screenshot preview on tab hover (requires activeTab permission)
settings.autoGroupNativeHint: When on, tabs aggregated by site or language are automatically grouped into browser-native tab groups (except opener-tree mode); turning it off disbands the groups created by this feature
settings.undoStackLimitHint: Maximum consecutive close operations that can be undone (oldest records are evicted beyond this)
settings.toastDurationHint: How long status toasts (e.g. "Closed N tabs") stay visible
settings.keepPinnedInCleanup: Keep pinned tabs when cleaning duplicates
settings.keepPinnedInCleanupHint: When off, the one-click duplicate cleanup will also clean pinned tabs if they are duplicates
settings.rowActionsVisibleHint: When off, row actions (mute/pin/duplicate etc.) appear on hover or focus
settings.pinyinSearchHint: Match Chinese tab titles by pinyin initials (e.g. "gh" hits Chinese titles before "GitHub")
settings.persistUndoHint: When off, undo records last only for the current session
settings.uniqueUrlTabsHint: When opening a URL that already exists, switch to the most recently accessed tab; if multiple tabs share the URL, keep the most recent and close the rest. When off, duplicate URLs are allowed

status.duplicateTitle: This URL has {{count}} duplicates in this window

toast.activeTabNotFound: There is no current tab to locate
toast.folderConvertSkipped: No web tabs to convert in this fixed folder
toast.folderConvertFailed: Failed to restore native tab group

errors.dataLoadFailed: Failed to load data. Check extension permissions.
